What you will build — and what the evidence says
MICRODUCK  /  SIMULATION EVIDENCE  /  11 SEP 2026
02
01
Use case: Teach how PPO turns a time-indexed joint clip into a balanced 50 Hz feedback controller, then prove motion with deterministic ONNX tracking and null controls.
02
By the end: describe the scene, map observations to actions, explain the reward, trace one PPO update, run a bounded experiment, and defend an evaluation claim.
03
The claim covers one eight-second excerpt, not the complete 60.923-second source clip or arbitrary choreography.
04
Scope: local MuJoCo simulation. Do not deploy these classroom artifacts to a physical robot; hardware transfer requires a separate validated process.

01
Nominal local MuJoCo with XML position actuators; physics dt 0.005 s, decimation 4, and control dt 0.02 s or 50 Hz.
02

04

slides.text:
PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  DANCE IMITATION: TIMED CHOREOGRAPHY AS FEEDBACK CONTROL
PPO: improve the actor without trusting a huge step
MICRODUCK  /  SIMULATION EVIDENCE  /  11 SEP 2026
10
ratio = πnew(a | o) / πold(a | o)
Maximize mean[min(ratio × A, clip(ratio, 1 − ε, 1 + ε) × A)]
Actor: chooses joint actions.   Critic: estimates future discounted reward.
A = advantage.  ε = clipping range.  Old log probabilities stay fixed for each collected batch.

slides.title: PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  DANCE IMITATION: TIMED CHOREOGRAPHY AS FEEDBACK CONTROL
slides.text:
PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  DANCE IMITATION: TIMED CHOREOGRAPHY AS FEEDBACK CONTROL
Follow one rollout through the learner
MICRODUCK  /  SIMULATION EVIDENCE  /  11 SEP 2026
11
01
Collect observations, sampled actions, old log probabilities, values, rewards and episode-boundary flags using the current stochastic actor.
02
Compute TD residuals and generalized advantage estimates (GAE). A true terminal has zero continuation value; a timeout may bootstrap the saved final observation.
03
Cut advantage traces at reset boundaries. Never bootstrap a timeout from the first observation of the next episode.
04
Reuse this batch for PPO minibatch updates, then collect fresh on-policy data. Export the deterministic actor and its observation transform for evaluation.

Paper exercise: count samples and clip the objective
MICRODUCK  /  SIMULATION EVIDENCE  /  11 SEP 2026
12
01
Illustrative arithmetic, NOT this run: 16 environments × 128 steps = 2,048 fresh transitions per rollout. Four epochs reuse those transitions; they do not create 8,192 new samples.
02
With ε = 0.2, ratio = 1.4 and A = +2: min(2.8, 2.4) = 2.4. The minimized policy term is −2.4 before averaging and additional loss terms.
03
With the same ratio and A = −2: min(−2.8, −2.4) = −2.8. Explain why clipping is asymmetric once the sign of the advantage changes.
04
Run from repo root: python3 docs/microduck-training-student-book/learning_lab.py --gae. This is a deterministic arithmetic lab, not new policy training.

Verification: define success before looking  ·  1/2
MICRODUCK  /  SIMULATION EVIDENCE  /  11 SEP 2026
26
01
Require every episode to complete 400 measured steps with no termination, contiguous phase coverage, finite traces, and at least 95% upright samples.
02
Require all-joint pose RMSE <= 0.15 rad, dynamic gain >= 0.20 over a constant-reference-mean baseline, and positive leg dynamic gain.
03
Require at least two moving leg joints; the selected reference has 12 moving joints and 8 moving leg joints at the 0.03 rad threshold.
04
Compare deterministic trained ONNX against zero action, an untrained network, and the trained network with phase inputs frozen.

01

03
The recipe changes both exploration scale and sample budget versus earlier failures, so their individual causal effects are not isolated.
04

MICRODUCK  /  仿真证据  /  2026年9月11日
10
似然比 ratio = πnew(a | o) / πold(a | o)
最大化 mean[min(ratio × A, clip(ratio, 1 − ε, 1 + ε) × A)]
策略网络（Actor）：选择关节动作。价值网络（Critic）：估计未来折扣奖励。
A 表示优势；ε 表示裁剪范围。每个采样批次的旧策略对数概率在更新时保持不变。

slides.title: PPO 机器人实验  /  舞蹈模仿：将定时编舞作为反馈控制
slides.text:

MICRODUCK  /  仿真证据  /  2026年9月11日
11
01
使用当前随机策略采集观测、采样动作、旧策略对数概率、价值估计、奖励以及回合边界标记。
02
计算时序差分残差和广义优势估计（GAE）。真正终止时，后续价值为零；超时截断时，可以使用保存的最终观测进行价值自举。
03
在重置边界切断优势递推。不得使用下一回合的初始观测，对上一回合的超时状态进行价值自举。
04
重复使用同一批数据进行 PPO 小批次更新，再采集新的同策略数据。评估时导出确定性策略网络及其观测变换。

01
教学算例，并非本次实验：16 个环境 × 128 步 = 每次采样得到 2,048 条新转移。四轮优化重复使用这些转移，并不会产生 8,192 条新样本。
02
当 ε = 0.2、ratio = 1.4、A = +2 时：min(2.8, 2.4) = 2.4。在求平均和加入其他损失项之前，被最小化的策略项为 −2.4。
03
保持相同的 ratio，令 A = −2：min(−2.8, −2.4) = −2.8。请解释：优势符号改变后，裁剪为何呈现不对称效果？
04
在仓库根目录运行：python3 docs/microduck-training-student-book/learning_lab.py --gae。这是确定性的算术练习，不会训练新策略。

ratio = πnew(a | o) / πold(a | o)
Maximize mean[min(ratio × A, clip(ratio, 1 − ε, 1 + ε) × A)]
Actor: chooses joint actions.   Critic: estimates future discounted reward.
A = advantage.  ε = clipping range.  Old log probabilities stay fixed for each collected batch.

10
似然比 ratio = πnew(a | o) / πold(a | o)
最大化 mean[min(ratio × A, clip(ratio, 1 − ε, 1 + ε) × A)]
策略网络（Actor）：选择关节动作。价值网络（Critic）：估计未来折扣奖励。
A 表示优势；ε 表示裁剪范围。每个采样批次的旧策略对数概率在更新时保持不变。

计算时序差分残差和广义优势估计（GAE）。真正终止时，后续价值为零；超时截断时，可以使用保存的最终观测进行价值自举。
03
在重置边界切断优势递推。不得使用下一回合的初始观测，对上一回合的超时状态进行价值自举。
04
重复使用同一批数据进行 PPO 小批次更新，再采集新的同策略数据。评估时导出确定性策略网络及其观测变换。

ratio = πnew(a | o) / πold(a | o)
Maximize mean[min(ratio × A, clip(ratio, 1 − ε, 1 + ε) × A)]
Actor: chooses joint actions.   Critic: estimates future discounted reward.
A = advantage.  ε = clipping range.  Old log probabilities stay fixed for each collected batch.

10
似然比 ratio = πnew(a | o) / πold(a | o)
最大化 mean[min(ratio × A, clip(ratio, 1 − ε, 1 + ε) × A)]
策略网络（Actor）：选择关节动作。价值网络（Critic）：估计未来折扣奖励。
A 表示优势；ε 表示裁剪范围。每个采样批次的旧策略对数概率在更新时保持不变。

slides.title: PPO 机器人实验  /  跑步：具有预期方向进展的腾空步态

11
01
使用当前随机策略采集观测、采样动作、旧策略对数概率、价值估计、奖励以及回合边界标记。
02
计算时序差分残差和广义优势估计（GAE）。真正终止时，后续价值为零；超时截断时，可以使用保存的最终观测进行价值自举。
03
在重置边界切断优势递推。不得使用下一回合的初始观测，对上一回合的超时状态进行价值自举。
04
重复使用同一批数据进行 PPO 小批次更新，再采集新的同策略数据。评估时导出确定性策略网络及其观测变换。

教学算例，并非本次实验：16 个环境 × 128 步 = 每次采样得到 2,048 条新转移。四轮优化重复使用这些转移，并不会产生 8,192 条新样本。
02
当 ε = 0.2、ratio = 1.4、A = +2 时：min(2.8, 2.4) = 2.4。在求平均和加入其他损失项之前，被最小化的策略项为 −2.4。
03
保持相同的 ratio，令 A = −2：min(−2.8, −2.4) = −2.8。请解释：优势符号改变后，裁剪为何呈现不对称效果？
04
在仓库根目录运行：python3 docs/microduck-training-student-book/learning_lab.py --gae。这是确定性的算术练习，不会训练新策略。

MICRODUCK  /  仿真证据  /  2026年9月11日
10
似然比 ratio = πnew(a | o) / πold(a | o)
最大化 mean[min(ratio × A, clip(ratio, 1 − ε, 1 + ε) × A)]
策略网络（Actor）：选择关节动作。价值网络（Critic）：估计未来折扣奖励。
A 表示优势；ε 表示裁剪范围。每个采样批次的旧策略对数概率在更新时保持不变。

使用当前随机策略采集观测、采样动作、旧策略对数概率、价值估计、奖励以及回合边界标记。
02
计算时序差分残差和广义优势估计（GAE）。真正终止时，后续价值为零；超时截断时，可以使用保存的最终观测进行价值自举。
03
在重置边界切断优势递推。不得使用下一回合的初始观测，对上一回合的超时状态进行价值自举。
04
重复使用同一批数据进行 PPO 小批次更新，再采集新的同策略数据。评估时导出确定性策略网络及其观测变换。

01
Use case: Teach controller ownership, transfer learning, PPO diagnostics, and evidence boundaries through a three-stage simulated backflip. The spotter owns launch energy and rotation, the trained PPO actor owns only the landing window, and the pretrained stand policy owns the final hold.
02
By the end: describe the scene, map observations to actions, explain the reward, trace one PPO update, run a bounded experiment, and defend an evaluation claim.
03
This is not an unassisted learned backflip. The simulator spotter supplies substantial launch energy and rotation.
04
Scope: local MuJoCo simulation. Do not deploy these classroom artifacts to a physical robot; hardware transfer requires a separate validated process.

05
01
Simulation only. Protocol spotter-launch-landing-stand-v2 uses explicit MuJoCo generalized external forces during launch; it does not teleport the robot.
02
Control contract: float32 observation shape 61 and action shape 14 at 50 Hz. Actions are 14 joint-target offsets in the fixed servo order.
03
Observation indices 0:3 are trunk angular velocity; 3:6 projected gravity; 6:20 joint position offsets; 20:34 one-control-step-lagged joint velocity; 34:48 previous raw action; 48:51 twist command; 51:55 head command; 55:61 body command.
04
The landing actor receives no extra stage, phase, world position, yaw, launch-force, or contact channel. Composite controller code knows the stage, but the PPO actor still receives the standard 61 values.

slides.title: PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  BACKFLIP: ASSISTED LAUNCH, PPO LANDING, AND STAND HANDOFF
slides.text:

Environment and policy contract  ·  2/3
MICRODUCK  /  SIMULATION EVIDENCE  /  11 SEP 2026
06
05
Launch duration is 1.2 s. The pitch target ends at 5.3 rad with target rate 5 rad/s; target height rises to 0.32 m and lowers toward 0.22 m before release.
06
Launch gains and clamps are pitch kp 1.5, pitch kd 0.24, pitch torque limit 1.3 Nm, vertical kp 90, vertical kd 8.5, vertical force limit 15 N, lateral damping 3, and roll/yaw damping 0.1.
07
Release must reach at least 5.3 rad with backward angular speed between 3.5 and 6.5 rad/s. All external forces and torques are cleared at release.
08
Handoff requires at least 5.8 rad credited rotation and 10 consecutive stable PPO samples: both feet supported, no non-foot support, upright projection at least 0.9, trunk height at least 0.105 m, gyro norm below sqrt(2) rad/s, and no spotter assistance.

PPO: improve the actor without trusting a huge step

12
ratio = πnew(a | o) / πold(a | o)
Maximize mean[min(ratio × A, clip(ratio, 1 − ε, 1 + ε) × A)]
Actor: chooses joint actions.   Critic: estimates future discounted reward.
A = advantage.  ε = clipping range.  Old log probabilities stay fixed for each collected batch.

Compute TD residuals and generalized advantage estimates (GAE). A true terminal has zero continuation value; a timeout may bootstrap the saved final observation.

Cut advantage traces at reset boundaries. Never bootstrap a timeout from the first observation of the next episode.

Illustrative arithmetic, NOT this run: 16 environments × 128 steps = 2,048 fresh transitions per rollout. Four epochs reuse those transitions; they do not create 8,192 new samples.

你将构建什么？现有证据说明了什么？

02
01
用例：通过三阶段仿真后空翻讲解控制器职责归属、迁移学习、PPO 诊断和证据边界。辅助器负责起跳能量和旋转，训练后的 PPO actor策略网络仅负责落地窗口，预训练站立策略负责最后的稳定站立。
02
学习目标：描述场景，解释观测到动作的映射和奖励，追踪一次 PPO 更新，运行有限预算实验，并用证据支撑评估结论。
03
这不是无辅助的学习后空翻。仿真器中的辅助器提供了大量起跳能量和旋转。
04
适用范围：本地 MuJoCo 仿真。请勿将课堂产物直接部署到实体机器人；硬件迁移需要独立且经过验证的流程。

05
01
仅限仿真。协议 spotter-launch-landing-stand-v2 在起跳期间使用显式 MuJoCo 广义外力；它不会瞬移机器人。
02
控制契约：float32 观测形状为 61，动作形状为 14，频率为 50 Hz。动作是按固定伺服器顺序排列的 14 个关节目标偏移量。
03
观测索引 0:3 为躯干角速度；3:6 为投影重力；6:20 为关节位置偏移量；20:34 为滞后一个控制步的关节速度；34:48 为上一个原始动作；48:51 为 twist 命令；51:55 为头部命令；55:61 为身体命令。
04
落地 actor策略网络不会收到额外的阶段、相位、世界位置、偏航角、起跳力或接触通道。组合控制器代码知道当前阶段，但 PPO actor策略网络仍只接收标准的 61 个值。

06
05
起跳持续时间为 1.2 s。俯仰目标终止于 5.3 rad，目标速率为 5 rad/s；目标高度升至 0.32 m，并在释放前朝 0.22 m 降低。
06
起跳增益和限幅为：俯仰 kp 1.5、俯仰 kd 0.24、俯仰扭矩上限 1.3 Nm、垂直 kp 90、垂直 kd 8.5、垂直力上限 15 N、横向阻尼 3，以及滚转/偏航阻尼 0.1。
07
释放时必须至少达到 5.3 rad，且向后角速度在 3.5 和 6.5 rad/s 之间。释放时清除所有外力和外部扭矩。
08
接管要求计入的旋转至少为 5.8 rad，并有连续 10 个稳定的 PPO 样本：双脚均受支撑、无非足部支撑、直立投影至少为 0.9、躯干高度至少为 0.105 m、陀螺仪范数低于 sqrt(2) rad/s，且没有辅助器帮助。

PPO：改进策略，同时避免盲目迈出过大一步
MICRODUCK  /  仿真证据  /  2026年9月11日
12
似然比 ratio = πnew(a | o) / πold(a | o)
最大化 mean[min(ratio × A, clip(ratio, 1 − ε, 1 + ε) × A)]
策略网络（Actor）：选择关节动作。价值网络（Critic）：估计未来折扣奖励。
A 表示优势；ε 表示裁剪范围。每个采样批次的旧策略对数概率在更新时保持不变。

01
The physical sphere center starts at z=0.121 m. The robot root starts at z=0.368 m, upright near the ball apex; the task does not teach climbing onto the ball or floor recovery.
02
The physics step is 0.005 s with four substeps per action, giving a 0.02 s control interval and 50 Hz policy rate.
03
Observation contract: float32[61]. Indices 0:3 trunk angular velocity; 3:6 projected gravity; 6:20 joint offsets; 20:34 one-step-lagged joint velocity; 34:48 previous raw action; 48:51 velocity command; 51:61 zero padding.
04
Action contract: 14 joint-target offsets. Applied targets are default pose plus clip(action, -4, 4); the observation preserves the previous raw action.

Hidden and cell state carry across ordinary steps and command changes, then reset on trial, episode, policy, environment, or recovery boundaries.

ratio = πnew(a | o) / πold(a | o)
Maximize mean[min(ratio × A, clip(ratio, 1 − ε, 1 + ε) × A)]
Actor: chooses joint actions.   Critic: estimates future discounted reward.
A = advantage.  ε = clipping range.  Old log probabilities stay fixed for each collected batch.

Illustrative arithmetic, NOT this run: 16 environments × 128 steps = 2,048 fresh transitions per rollout. Four epochs reuse those transitions; they do not create 8,192 new samples.

你将构建什么？现有证据说明了什么？

02
01
用途：讲授循环策略状态、actor 策略网络热启动、物理辅助课程以及诚实的任务分解。保留的策略展示了在可自由移动的篮球上无辅助持续保持平衡，但尚未掌握按指令滚动和一般转向。
02
学习目标：描述场景，解释观测到动作的映射和奖励，追踪一次 PPO 更新，运行有限预算实验，并用证据支撑评估结论。
03
展示的结果是保持平衡，而不是维持静止的世界坐标位置、按指令滚动或转向。
04
适用范围：本地 MuJoCo 仿真。请勿将课堂产物直接部署到实体机器人；硬件迁移需要独立且经过验证的流程。

环境与策略接口约定  ·  1/3

06
01
物理球体中心初始位于 z=0.121 m。机器人根部初始位于 z=0.368 m，在球顶附近保持直立；本任务不教授爬上篮球或从地面恢复。
02
物理步长为 0.005 s，每个动作包含四个子步，因此控制间隔为 0.02 s，策略频率为 50 Hz。
03
观测约定：float32[61]。索引 0:3 为躯干角速度；3:6 为投影重力；6:20 为关节偏移；20:34 为滞后一拍的关节速度；34:48 为上一个原始动作；48:51 为速度指令；51:61 为零填充。
04
动作约定：14 个关节目标偏移。实际目标为默认姿态加 clip(action, -4, 4)；观测保留上一个原始动作。

07
05
actor 策略网络不会接收球的位置、速度、旋转、接触、半径或世界坐标位置信号。它是盲式循环 actor 策略网络，只能通过本体感知历史推断动力学。
06
循环 ONNX 输入为 obs [1,61]、h_in [1,1,256] 和 c_in [1,1,256]；输出为 actions [1,14]、h_out [1,1,256] 和 c_out [1,1,256]。
07
隐藏状态和细胞状态会跨普通步骤及指令变化延续，并在试验、回合、策略、环境或恢复边界处重置。
08
物理辅助阶梯的 hold 级别为 1、0.5、0.25、0.1、0.03 和 0。它只通过仿真施加恢复力和恢复力矩；奖励保持不变。

10

01
木板是初始中心位于 (0,0,0.225) m 的 MuJoCo 自由刚体。四根物理肌腱将木板连接点与锚点相连，锚点位于 x +/-0.45 m、y +/-0.17 m、z 0.77 m。
02
标称木板横跨 x=-0.55 到 0.55 m。起点和终点平台中心分别位于 x=-0.85 m 和 x=0.85 m，所有顶面均位于 z=0.24 m。
03
可见门架使用 contype=0 和 conaffinity=0。它无法支撑或挽救机器人；只有肌腱、平台、木板和地面参与接触动力学。
04
物理仿真以 0.005 s 运行，每个 14 维动作指令包含四个子步，因此控制间隔为 0.02 s，频率为 50 Hz。

06
actor 策略网络不会接收木板位置、速度、横滚角、俯仰角、缆索状态、世界坐标位置、桥面接触、穿越标志或辅助级别。
07
外部导航指令器使用世界坐标中的躯干 x/y 和朝向来发布普通机体坐标系 twist 指令。它给出标称 0.25 m/s 前进速度、横向修正 clip(-1.2*y, -0.12, 0.12)，以及偏航修正 clip(-1.5*yaw_error, -0.6, 0.6)。
08
当世界坐标 x 至少达到 0.80 m 时，指令器将期望前进速度设为零，同时保留横向和偏航修正。

slides.title: PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  COLORED-DUCK PAINTING: SUCCESSFUL BRUSH-V2 FEEDBACK CONTROL
slides.text:
PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  COLORED-DUCK PAINTING: SUCCESSFUL BRUSH-V2 FEEDBACK CONTROL
What you will build — and what the evidence says
MICRODUCK  /  SIMULATION EVIDENCE  /  11 SEP 2026
02
01
Use case: MicroDuck paints a fixed four-color swimming duck with a preloaded free brush in MuJoCo. The released brush-color-v2-03 ONNX passes 40/40 required episodes. Teach the complete teacher-data, ridge BC, DAgger, anchored PPO, export and verification pipeline. Matching BC also passes 40/40: PPO preserved successful behavior, not demonstrated improvement. Historical pencil failures remain separate evidence.
02
By the end: describe the scene, map observations to actions, explain the reward, trace one PPO update, run a bounded experiment, and defend an evaluation claim.
03
Successful fixed-template simulated painting is now supported. The earlier pencil experiments were not retroactively successful, and a new 93/15 brush contract is not a replacement for stock 61/14 deployment.
04
Scope: local MuJoCo simulation. Do not deploy these classroom artifacts to a physical robot; hardware transfer requires a separate validated process.

slides.title: PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  COLORED-DUCK PAINTING: SUCCESSFUL BRUSH-V2 FEEDBACK CONTROL
slides.text:
PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  COLORED-DUCK PAINTING: SUCCESSFUL BRUSH-V2 FEEDBACK CONTROL
Materials and prerequisites  ·  1/2
MICRODUCK  /  SIMULATION EVIDENCE  /  11 SEP 2026
03
01
A full-collision MicroDuck simulation, canvas and easel; 14 original joint controls plus one simulated lower-jaw action. This is an educational model, not a hardware bill of materials.
02
One free brush held between upper/lower beak pads through the pencil_free joint. It is preloaded, not welded to the head; autonomous pickup is outside this case.
03
One passive compliant contact tuft: sphere radius 1.0 mm, mass 0.00003 kg, bristle_compression travel -3.0 to 0.3 mm. Three decorative hairs and a ferrule are visual, not separate flexible-contact bristles.
04
A passive spring with stiffness 25 N/m, damping 0.32 N s/m, armature 0.001 kg and default grip friction 1.2. It adds compliance, not a sixteenth motor.

slides.title: PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  COLORED-DUCK PAINTING: SUCCESSFUL BRUSH-V2 FEEDBACK CONTROL
slides.text:
PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  COLORED-DUCK PAINTING: SUCCESSFUL BRUSH-V2 FEEDBACK CONTROL
Materials and prerequisites  ·  2/2
MICRODUCK  /  SIMULATION EVIDENCE  /  11 SEP 2026
04
05
Four physical paint wells: gold, orange, charcoal and blue; one non-contact palette backing. Tip contact loads discrete pigment; no fluid mixing, washing or residual-paint dynamics are simulated.
06
Existing CPU Python environment with MuJoCo, Torch, Stable-Baselines3, Gymnasium, NumPy, ONNX, ONNX Runtime, Pillow and FFmpeg. Use rlx/.venv-microduck/bin/python; source/model compatibility matters more than an unverified package upgrade.
07
Retained artifacts: final-seed11 teacher dataset and sidecar; brush-color-v2-03 archived source package, training metadata, BC/PPO checkpoints, frozen ONNX files, evaluations and actual-contact video. A slides-only ZIP does not include every weight or training dependency.

slides.title: PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  COLORED-DUCK PAINTING: SUCCESSFUL BRUSH-V2 FEEDBACK CONTROL
slides.text:
PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  COLORED-DUCK PAINTING: SUCCESSFUL BRUSH-V2 FEEDBACK CONTROL
Environment and policy contract  ·  1/3
MICRODUCK  /  SIMULATION EVIDENCE  /  11 SEP 2026
05
01
Current contract: microduck-brush-v2, 93 observations and 15 actions, simulation_only with hardware_compatible=false. Historical pencil uses microduck-drawing-v1 83/15. Neither can hot-swap into stock 61/14 walking deployment.
02
Observations 0:61 retain IMU angular velocity, projected gravity, 14 relative joint positions, prior joint velocities/actions and zeroed reserved command slots. Observations 61:83 add mouth state, tip/target geometry, velocities, pen-down request and contact forces.
03
Brush tail 83:87 = loaded-color one-hot; 87:91 = planned-color one-hot; 91 = compression in millimeters; 92 = trajectory mode divided by 2. The current actor does not consume 83:93: color planning and missed-dip recovery are not learned.
04
Actions 0:14 address the original joints; action[14] maps to mouth_target = 0.24 + 0.36 * action[14]. The structured head actor predicts a delta bounded to 0.025 per step and adds it to the previous action only at output.

slides.title: PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  COLORED-DUCK PAINTING: SUCCESSFUL BRUSH-V2 FEEDBACK CONTROL
slides.text:
PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  COLORED-DUCK PAINTING: SUCCESSFUL BRUSH-V2 FEEDBACK CONTROL
Environment and policy contract  ·  2/3
MICRODUCK  /  SIMULATION EVIDENCE  /  11 SEP 2026
06
05
Head features combine position, target error, brush direction, contact force and quadratic interactions. Ankles use linear gravity/angular-velocity feedback; other body joints and the jaw learn constant offsets. This is a structured learned feedback policy, not an unconstrained image-to-action network.
06
Physics timestep 0.002 s gives 500 Hz; 10 substeps give 0.020 s control at 50 Hz. A completed reference trajectory contains 5,998 control steps, measured as 119.96 s despite the 120 s command budget.
07
Pigment loads only after actual tip/well force above 0.0001 N. Canvas marks use actual MuJoCo tip contact and the currently loaded color, not reference pixels pasted onto the canvas.
08
The fixed duck pattern, color assignment, stroke sequence and approach/dip/lift targets are authored. The learned motor controller follows that plan without a runtime Jacobian teacher. No camera, image recognition or arbitrary visual composition is claimed.

slides.text:
PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  COLORED-DUCK PAINTING: SUCCESSFUL BRUSH-V2 FEEDBACK CONTROL
Build the case step by step  ·  1/2
MICRODUCK  /  SIMULATION EVIDENCE  /  11 SEP 2026
09
01
First preserve the history: drawing-pilot-01 and drawing-refinement-02 each used 32,768 PPO transitions and failed pencil acceptance. Their teacher feasibility video is not a successful learned policy.
02
Diagnosis found a confirmed configuration defect: intended initial_std=0.005 was reset to effective 0.02 after BC. Both historical PPO policies also drifted from BC. These observations do not prove a single cause for every failure.
03
Build a separate brush-v2 contract with compliant contact, physical color wells and a structured action-delta actor. Multiple changes occurred together, so do not attribute the entire improvement to PPO or brush compliance alone.
04
Archive training sources before collecting data. With data seed 11, the analytic Jacobian teacher provides eight 5,998-step episodes: 47,984 initial labeled observations/actions.

slides.title: PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  COLORED-DUCK PAINTING: SUCCESSFUL BRUSH-V2 FEEDBACK CONTROL
slides.text:
PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  COLORED-DUCK PAINTING: SUCCESSFUL BRUSH-V2 FEEDBACK CONTROL
Build the case step by step  ·  2/2
MICRODUCK  /  SIMULATION EVIDENCE  /  11 SEP 2026
10
05
Fit ridge BC with ridge=0.01. Relabel student-visited states in two DAgger rounds and refit; dataset sizes become 47,984, 77,974 and 105,858. These are supervised fit records, not fresh PPO transitions.
06
Warm-start PPO with training seed 101, small per-action noise and learning_rate=1e-7. Collect 49,152 genuine on-policy transitions; evaluate deterministic action drift on saved BC/DAgger anchor observations after each update.
07
Accept an update only when maximum drift is finite and <=0.00025; otherwise restore policy parameters and optimizer state. Export immutable deterministic PPO and matching BC ONNX with static 93-input/15-output interfaces.
08
Run identical independent acceptance suites on both models, verify source/model hashes, inspect all failures and negative controls, then render the same PPO ONNX. The final gate passes; this lesson does not rerun training.

slides.title: PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  COLORED-DUCK PAINTING: SUCCESSFUL BRUSH-V2 FEEDBACK CONTROL
slides.text:
PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  COLORED-DUCK PAINTING: SUCCESSFUL BRUSH-V2 FEEDBACK CONTROL
PPO: improve the actor without trusting a huge step
MICRODUCK  /  SIMULATION EVIDENCE  /  11 SEP 2026
11
ratio = πnew(a | o) / πold(a | o)
Maximize mean[min(ratio × A, clip(ratio, 1 − ε, 1 + ε) × A)]
Actor: chooses joint actions.   Critic: estimates future discounted reward.
A = advantage.  ε = clipping range.  Old log probabilities stay fixed for each collected batch.

slides.title: PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  COLORED-DUCK PAINTING: SUCCESSFUL BRUSH-V2 FEEDBACK CONTROL
slides.text:
PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  COLORED-DUCK PAINTING: SUCCESSFUL BRUSH-V2 FEEDBACK CONTROL
Follow one rollout through the learner
MICRODUCK  /  SIMULATION EVIDENCE  /  11 SEP 2026
12
01
Collect observations, sampled actions, old log probabilities, values, rewards and episode-boundary flags using the current stochastic actor.
02
Compute TD residuals and generalized advantage estimates (GAE). A true terminal has zero continuation value; a timeout may bootstrap the saved final observation.
03
Cut advantage traces at reset boundaries. Never bootstrap a timeout from the first observation of the next episode.
04
Reuse this batch for PPO minibatch updates, then collect fresh on-policy data. Export the deterministic actor and its observation transform for evaluation.

slides.title: PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  COLORED-DUCK PAINTING: SUCCESSFUL BRUSH-V2 FEEDBACK CONTROL
slides.text:
PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  COLORED-DUCK PAINTING: SUCCESSFUL BRUSH-V2 FEEDBACK CONTROL
Paper exercise: count samples and clip the objective
MICRODUCK  /  SIMULATION EVIDENCE  /  11 SEP 2026
13
01
Illustrative arithmetic, NOT this run: 16 environments × 128 steps = 2,048 fresh transitions per rollout. Four epochs reuse those transitions; they do not create 8,192 new samples.
02
With ε = 0.2, ratio = 1.4 and A = +2: min(2.8, 2.4) = 2.4. The minimized policy term is −2.4 before averaging and additional loss terms.
03
With the same ratio and A = −2: min(−2.8, −2.4) = −2.8. Explain why clipping is asymmetric once the sign of the advantage changes.
04
Run from repo root: python3 docs/microduck-training-student-book/learning_lab.py --gae. This is a deterministic arithmetic lab, not new policy training.

slides.title: PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  COLORED-DUCK PAINTING: SUCCESSFUL BRUSH-V2 FEEDBACK CONTROL
slides.text:
PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  COLORED-DUCK PAINTING: SUCCESSFUL BRUSH-V2 FEEDBACK CONTROL
Reward design: what the agent is paid to do  ·  1/2
MICRODUCK  /  SIMULATION EVIDENCE  /  11 SEP 2026
14
01
tracking = 2.0 * exp(-(tip_target_distance / 0.006)^2): a smooth local tracking reward. The 6 mm reward scale is not the stricter 1.5 mm final scoring tolerance.
02
contact = 0.4 when actual mark presence matches the requested pen-down state. Correct pen-up travel can also receive this reward; constant contact is not the goal.
03
grasp = 0.3 for maintaining grasp through the physics substeps; upright = 0.3 * max(0, trunk_upright). Balance and retention support, but do not replace, image-geometry acceptance.
04
action_rate_penalty = -0.01 * sum((action - previous_action)^2) discourages abrupt control changes.

slides.title: PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  COLORED-DUCK PAINTING: SUCCESSFUL BRUSH-V2 FEEDBACK CONTROL
slides.text:
PPO ROBOTICS LAB  /  COLORED-DUCK PAINTING: SUCCESSFUL BRUSH-V2 FEEDBACK CONTROL
Reward design: what the agent is paid to do  ·  2/2
MICRODUCK  /  SIMULATION EVIDENCE  /  11 SEP 2026
15
05
force_penalty = -0.02 * max(0, canvas_force - 0.5)^2. Final validation separately enforces peak force below 0.5 N.
06
color = 0.4 when loaded_color equals desired_color. It rewards the achieved contact state; it does not prove the actor learned a color plan, because the actor ignores the added color tail.
07
The environment returns the sum of these step rewards. Logs retain reward_mean, not a complete episodic-return series. A higher reward or accepted anchor update does not automatically mean a better painting.

Ten required configurations: nominal; offset (0.002,0.002) m; scale 0.95; grip friction 0.9; brush stiffness 30 N/m; combined_left; combined_small; combined_right; boundary_large; boundary_soft. Each must pass all four seeds.

02
01
用例：MicroDuck 在 MuJoCo 中使用预先装入的自由画笔，绘制固定的四色游泳鸭。已发布的 brush-color-v2-03 ONNX 通过了要求的 40/40 个回合。讲授完整的教师数据、岭回归 BC、DAgger、锚定 PPO、导出和验证流水线。匹配的 BC 也通过了 40/40：PPO 保留了成功行为，并未证明有所改进。历史铅笔失败仍是独立证据。
02
学习目标：描述场景，解释观测到动作的映射和奖励，追踪一次 PPO 更新，运行有限预算实验，并用证据支撑评估结论。
03
现在已支持成功的固定模板仿真绘画。较早的铅笔实验并未被追溯改判为成功，新的 93/15 画笔契约也不能替代标准 61/14 部署。
04

01
当前契约：microduck-brush-v2，93 个观测和 15 个动作，simulation_only 且 hardware_compatible=false。历史铅笔使用 microduck-drawing-v1 83/15。两者都不能热切换到标准 61/14 行走部署中。

观测 0:61 保留 IMU 角速度、投影重力、14 个相对关节位置、先前的关节速度/动作以及清零的预留命令槽。观测 61:83 增加嘴部状态、笔尖/目标几何关系、速度、落笔请求和接触力。

画笔尾部 83:87 = 已加载颜色 one-hot；87:91 = 计划颜色 one-hot；91 = 以毫米为单位的压缩量；92 = 轨迹模式除以 2。当前 actor 不使用 83:93：颜色规划和漏蘸恢复并非学习所得。
04
动作 0:14 控制原始关节；action[14] 映射为 mouth_target = 0.24 + 0.36 * action[14]。结构化头部 actor 预测每步限制在 0.025 以内的增量，并且仅在输出时将其加到前一个动作上。

头部特征组合位置、目标误差、画笔方向、接触力和二次交互项。踝关节使用线性重力/角速度反馈；其他身体关节和下颚学习常量偏移。这是结构化的学习型反馈策略，不是不受约束的图像到动作网络。
06
物理时间步 0.002 s 对应 500 Hz；10 个子步形成 0.020 s 的控制周期，即 50 Hz。完整参考轨迹包含 5,998 个控制步，实测为 119.96 s，尽管命令预算为 120 s。

01
首先保留历史事实：drawing-pilot-01 和 drawing-refinement-02 各使用了 32,768 个 PPO transitions，且均未通过铅笔验收。它们的教师可行性视频并不是成功的学习策略。

在收集数据前归档训练源代码。使用数据种子 11 时，解析雅可比教师提供八个 5,998 步回合：共 47,984 条初始标注观测/动作。

05
使用 ridge=0.01 拟合岭回归 BC。在两轮 DAgger 中重新标注学生访问的状态并再次拟合；数据集大小依次变为 47,984、77,974 和 105,858。这些是监督拟合记录，不是新的 PPO transitions。

使用训练种子 101、较小的逐动作噪声和 learning_rate=1e-7 热启动 PPO。收集 49,152 个真正的同策略 transitions；每次更新后，在保存的 BC/DAgger 锚点观测上评估确定性动作漂移。

仅当最大漂移为有限值且 <=0.00025 时接受更新；否则恢复策略参数和优化器状态。导出不可变的确定性 PPO 和匹配 BC ONNX，使用静态 93-input/15-output 接口。

对两个模型运行完全相同的独立验收套件，验证源代码/模型哈希，检查所有失败和负对照，然后渲染同一个 PPO ONNX。最终门槛通过；本课程不会重新运行训练。

slides.text:
PPO 机器人实验室  /  彩色鸭绘画：成功的 BRUSH-V2 反馈控制
PPO：改进策略，同时避免盲目迈出过大一步
MICRODUCK  /  仿真证据  /  2026年9月11日
11
似然比 ratio = πnew(a | o) / πold(a | o)
最大化 mean[min(ratio × A, clip(ratio, 1 − ε, 1 + ε) × A)]
策略网络（Actor）：选择关节动作。价值网络（Critic）：估计未来折扣奖励。
A 表示优势；ε 表示裁剪范围。每个采样批次的旧策略对数概率在更新时保持不变。

slides.title: PPO 机器人实验室  /  彩色鸭绘画：成功的 BRUSH-V2 反馈控制
slides.text:
PPO 机器人实验室  /  彩色鸭绘画：成功的 BRUSH-V2 反馈控制
沿着一次轨迹采样，理解学习器的处理过程
MICRODUCK  /  仿真证据  /  2026年9月11日
12
01
使用当前随机策略采集观测、采样动作、旧策略对数概率、价值估计、奖励以及回合边界标记。
02
计算时序差分残差和广义优势估计（GAE）。真正终止时，后续价值为零；超时截断时，可以使用保存的最终观测进行价值自举。
03
在重置边界切断优势递推。不得使用下一回合的初始观测，对上一回合的超时状态进行价值自举。
04
重复使用同一批数据进行 PPO 小批次更新，再采集新的同策略数据。评估时导出确定性策略网络及其观测变换。

slides.text:

纸笔练习：计算样本数与裁剪目标
MICRODUCK  /  仿真证据  /  2026年9月11日
13
01
教学算例，并非本次实验：16 个环境 × 128 步 = 每次采样得到 2,048 条新转移。四轮优化重复使用这些转移，并不会产生 8,192 条新样本。
02
当 ε = 0.2、ratio = 1.4、A = +2 时：min(2.8, 2.4) = 2.4。在求平均和加入其他损失项之前，被最小化的策略项为 −2.4。
03
保持相同的 ratio，令 A = −2：min(−2.8, −2.4) = −2.8。请解释：优势符号改变后，裁剪为何呈现不对称效果？
04
在仓库根目录运行：python3 docs/microduck-training-student-book/learning_lab.py --gae。这是确定性的算术练习，不会训练新策略。

slides.text:

奖励设计：智能体因何获得奖励？  ·  1/2
MICRODUCK  /  仿真证据  /  2026年9月11日
14
01
tracking = 2.0 * exp(-(tip_target_distance / 0.006)^2)：平滑的局部跟踪奖励。6 mm 的奖励尺度并不是更严格的 1.5 mm 最终评分容差。
02
当实际标记存在状态与请求的落笔状态一致时，contact = 0.4。正确的抬笔移动也可获得此奖励；持续接触并非目标。
03
维持整个物理子步期间的夹持时，grasp = 0.3；upright = 0.3 * max(0, trunk_upright)。平衡和夹持保持提供支持，但不能取代图像几何验收。
04
action_rate_penalty = -0.01 * sum((action - previous_action)^2) 用于抑制突变的控制动作。

15
05
force_penalty = -0.02 * max(0, canvas_force - 0.5)^2。最终验证还会单独要求峰值力低于 0.5 N。
06
当 loaded_color 等于 desired_color 时，color = 0.4。它奖励的是已实现的接触状态；这不能证明 actor 学会了颜色计划，因为 actor 忽略新增的颜色尾部观测。
07
环境返回这些逐步奖励之和。日志保留 reward_mean，而非完整的回合回报序列。更高的奖励或被接受的锚点更新并不自动意味着绘画质量更好。

16
01
选定运行：rlx/runs/studio/drawing/brush-color-v2-03。数据种子 11；训练种子 101；数据集 SHA-256 记录在 training.json 中，并在拟合前与教师侧车文件进行验证。

岭回归 BC：0.01；两轮 DAgger。各次拟合后的归一化增量 MSE：8.067842827585991e-06、1.9331184375914745e-05 和 3.993013524450362e-05。由于数据集发生变化，这些值不适合作为一条单调可比的学习曲线。
03
一个环境；n_steps=6144；八次 rollout 产生 49,152 个新的 transitions。batch_size=512 使每个 epoch 包含 12 个 minibatch；n_epochs=2 是复用数据，而不是将仿真器 transitions 翻倍。
04
PPO learning_rate=1e-7；gamma=0.995；gae_lambda=0.95；clip_range=0.05；target_kl=0.002；max_grad_norm=0.3。这些数值来自已归档的训练脚本，并非通用 PPO 默认值。

使用基于 4,096 的步幅，从 BC/DAgger 数据中对锚点观测进行子采样。每次更新都将确定性动作与保存的 BC/DAgger actor 进行比较；最大允许漂移为 0.00025。
07
全部八次 PPO 更新都通过了漂移门槛。记录的最大 anchor_max_drift 为 0.00015974044799804688。验收表示动作漂移约束得到满足，并不代表图像质量存在因果增益。
08
ONNX 一致性 max_absolute_error=1.4901161193847656e-08，passed=true。PPO ONNX SHA-256：6e083a2a1a0e3114016be9ef0d377d9e9245648ca174303c5f8d0340bdf4500e。

02
十种必测配置：nominal；offset (0.002,0.002) m；scale 0.95；grip friction 0.9；brush stiffness 30 N/m；combined_left；combined_small；combined_right；boundary_large；boundary_soft。每种配置的全部四个种子都必须通过。
03
组合门槛同时改变 offset、scale、friction 和 stiffness。边界覆盖 scale 0.88 至 1.12、grip friction 0.8，以及 stiffness 18 至 40 N/m；精确配置保留在 raw/drawing/eval.json 和源工作流中。
04
对于金色、橙色、炭黑色和蓝色中的每一种颜色：在几何容差 0.0015 m 下，coverage >=0.95 且 precision >=0.95。要求完整的 5,998 步轨迹、无跌倒/掉落且 assistance=0。
